,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"138\",\"lineNum\":76,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"例皆一也。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"139\",\"lineNum\":76,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"伏孔四，所以便用事也。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"140\",\"lineNum\":76,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"一曰正角，出于商上者也；二曰倍角，近笛下者\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"141\",\"lineNum\":77,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"也；三曰變宫，近于宫孔，倍令下者也；四曰變徴，逺于徵孔，倍令髙者也。或倍或半，或四分一，取則于琴徽也。四\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"142\",\"lineNum\":78,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"者皆不作其孔，而取其度，以應進退上下之法，所以協聲均，便事用也。其本孔隠而不見，故曰伏孔。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"143\",\"lineNum\":79,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"大吕之笛：正聲應大吕，下徵應夷則，長二尺六寸六分\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"144\",\"lineNum\":80,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"三𨤲有竒。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596013879337","endPageId":"7519875596013944873","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":12226,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":5,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817054246","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"145\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596013961257\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"146\",\"lineNum\":83,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"太蔟之笛：正聲應太蔟，下徵應南吕，長二尺五寸三分\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"147\",\"lineNum\":84,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"一𨤲有竒。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"t :1,\"content\":\"清角，特旋宮之二調耳，十二笛皆有之。然唯黄鍾笛\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"183\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014026793\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"184\",\"lineNum\":120,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"為徴角正聲，故可用；餘笛非正聲，故不可用。古人言\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"185\",\"lineNum\":121,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"下徵、清角，專言黄鍾之下徵、清角也。二調所假用之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"186\",\"lineNum\":122,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"律雖皆濁，一律在笛，則七聲流轉循環，自然互相為\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"187\",\"lineNum\":123,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"用，不必倂發三孔及哨吹令清也。又朂所制尺過于\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"188\",\"lineNum\":124,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"短小，始朂因杜夔所制律吕，檢校太樂八音，始知後\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"189\",\"lineNum\":125,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"漢至魏尺度漸長于古四分有餘，乃令劉恭依周禮\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"190\",\"lineNum\":126,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"更積黍起度，以鑄新律。晉武以其與周漢器合，故施\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"191\",\"lineNum\":127,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"用之。然當時阮咸譏其聲髙，非興國之音，以田父玉\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"192\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014043177\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"193\",\"lineNum\":129,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"尺校之，則短一黍，以所得古銅尺校之，則短四分。故\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"194\",\"lineNum\":130,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"周宣時達奚震、牛𢎞謂晉、梁尺俱過于短小。按山謙\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"195\",\"lineNum\":131,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"之記云：梁殿前三鐘，悉是周景王所鑄無射也。遣樂\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"196\",\"lineNum\":132,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"官以今無射笛飲，不相中；以夷則笛飲，則聲韻合和。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"197\",\"lineNum\":133,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"是梁武之律髙于周鐘二律也。梁法尺比晉前尺長\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"198\",\"lineNum\":134,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"七釐尚如此，則朂律之短可知。毛西河謂今之簫制\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"199\",\"lineNum\":135,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"全合古法，故據今之簫孔，用朂之律名，于律則合度，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"200\",\"lineNum\":136,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"于聲則得中，六字調為黄鐘正宫無疑也。每笛各有\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"201\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014059561\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"202\",\"lineNum\":138,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"七調，十二笛可得八十四調，而朂不言者，十二笛之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"203\",\"lineNum\":139,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"旋宫總不出乎十二調也。京房六十律，朂俱不用者，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"204\",\"lineNum\":140,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"以律止十二，縱多為之，律亦無所施也。唐祖孝孫用\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"205\",\"lineNum\":141,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"八十四調，張文收為銅律三百六十，竟何禆于樂制？\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"206\",\"lineNum\":142,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"朂之識過後人逺矣。史稱朂于千載之外，推百代之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\ "marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"215\",\"lineNum\":152,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"依律作大吕笛以示和，又吹七律，一孔一校，聲皆相應。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"216\",\"lineNum\":153,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"然後令郝生鼓筝，宋同吹笛，以為襍引、相和諸曲。和乃\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"217\",\"lineNum\":154,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"辭曰：自和父祖漢世以來，笛家相傳，不知此法，而令調\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"218\",\"lineNum\":155,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"均與律相應，實非所及也。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014075945","endPageId":"7519875596014075945","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":1016,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":15,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817218086","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"219\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014092329\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"220\",\"lineNum\":158,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"昔人用笛，長短不一，故有三尺二、二尺九等名。自朂\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"221\",\"lineNum\":159,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"制十二笛，始各如本律之名。然一笛已應七律，旋之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"222\",\"lineNum\":160,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"已得七調，但缺大吕、夾鍾、中吕、夷則、無射五律之聲\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"223\",\"lineNum\":161,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"耳。朂欲作十二笛，先作大吕一笛，吹七律以相校，聲\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"224\",\"lineNum\":162,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"均皆合。有黄鐘笛，更得此笛，則十二律畢具，旋宫無\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNote "logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"665\",\"lineNum\":287,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"匠曲尺度之，除吹口適得九寸，以是為黄鍾之聲可\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"666\",\"lineNum\":288,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"也。若笛體中，則雖名尺八，實盈二尺，決非黄鍾之聲。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"667\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014403625\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"668\",\"lineNum\":290,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"且雅樂不用二變，猶今南曲不用一、凡，而彼以一為\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"669\",\"lineNum\":291,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"角，與調法不合。其俗樂以閏為角，又與律次相乖。于\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"670\",\"lineNum\":292,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"是強増中吕，虗設蕤賓，上勾之字不明，角、徵之音不\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"671\",\"lineNum\":293,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"正，皆所謂今笛者誤之也。儒者講求律吕，或不憚排\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"672\",\"lineNum\":294,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"衆議以抒己見，惟笛律則俱以笛體中為黄鍾，數百\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"673\",\"lineNum\":295,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"年來無異辭。至于晉、宋二史所載荀朂笛譜，竟無一人\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"674\",\"lineNum\":296,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"置之齒牙間，真不可解。但知黄鍾律最長，聲最濁，因\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"675\",\"lineNum\":297,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"取笛之最下一聲為黄鍾，不知黄鍾本屬中聲，而短\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"676\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014420009\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"677\",\"lineNum\":299,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"律又有濁倍也。荀朂黄鍾笛正聲調法，實今之六字\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"678\",\"lineNum\":300,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"調，其黄鍾孔實六字調之上字，緣當時未有字譜，故\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"679\",\"lineNum\":301,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"但著律名爾。欲求黄鍾正聲，斷宜依古笛法。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014387241","endPageId":"7519875596014420009","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":3143,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":37,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817578534","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"680\",\"lineNum\":302,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"唐、宋史皆謂當時俗樂以夾鍾為黄鍾，其實非也。宋\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"681\",\"lineNum\":303,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"史明云俗樂以變徵為宫，則是以雅樂之蕤賓為黄\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"682\",\"lineNum\":304,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"鍾也。而又云燕樂聲髙，實以夾鍾為黄鍾，何其矛楯\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"683\",\"lineNum\":305,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"若此！以荀譜言之，當時俗樂實以太蔟為黄鍾，即今\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"684\",\"lineNum\":306,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"之正宫調也。以商為宫，其名不正，當呼五字調，而以\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"685\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014436393\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"686\",\"lineNum\":308,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"正宫之名還黄鍾。其餘調名並宜改正。但俗樂相沿\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"687\",\"lineNum\":309,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"已久，一旦盡易舊名，聽者易惑。止改正宫一調之名，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"688\",\"lineNum\":310,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"餘悉仍舊，于義無乖。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014420009","endPageId":"7519875596014436393","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":1235,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":38,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817594918","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"689\",\"lineNum\":311,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"俗樂舊有倍四、倍五之器，失之太清。唐志：倍四本屬清樂，形類雅音，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"690\",\"lineNum\":312,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"而曲出于胡部。宋史姜䕫言有倍四之器，銀字中管之號。又有中管倍五者，以意裁奪，不合正律，失之太\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"691\",\"lineNum\":313,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"清。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"692\",\"lineNum\":313,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"今簫色有背四、急工二調，亦失之太髙。歌曲有低\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"693\",\"lineNum\":314,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"字、無髙字者始可用，否則可吹而不可歌也。背四即\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"694\",\"lineNum\":315,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"尺字調，髙吹體中翕聲為四，借發後出孔，故名背四\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"695\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014452777\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"696\",\"lineNum\":317,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"也。急工即工字調，髙吹盡發前五孔為工，其聲髙急，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"697\",\"lineNum\":318,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"故名急工也。此二調即尺、工二調，簫色有之，笛色則\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"698\",\"lineNum\":319,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"無。所謂銀字者，即大吕之管也。當時不謂之大吕，而\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"699\",\"lineNum\":320,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"加銀字之名。其起應鍾為宫者，所以備大吕均之五\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"700\",\"lineNum\":321,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"律也。而號中管之格，遂若銀字中管，惟俗樂所用，而\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"701\",\"lineNum\":322,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"不知其為應大吕一均之器也。有大吕笛，而銀字中\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"702\",\"lineNum\":323,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"管皆可以不設矣。下徵，尺字調也。清徵，背四調也。雅\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"703\",\"lineNum\":324,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"樂聲尚和平，林鍾調已髙急，故調自林鍾以下，勢不\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"704\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014469161\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"705\",\"lineNum\":326,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"得不飜髙作低。荀朂譜于蕤、林兩笛，皆倍半令下，是\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"706\",\"lineNum\":327,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"其翻髙作低，始于蕤賓。按周禮奏蕤賓，歌函鍾。蕤賓\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"707\",\"lineNum\":328,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"曰奏，不嫌已髙；函鍾曰歌，不容過抗。故蕤實可用正\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"708\",\"lineNum\":329,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"聲，林鍾宜為下徵也。蓋自清角而上，上則益清；下徴\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"709\",\"lineNum\":330,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"而下，下則益濁。故髙調至上字調而止，低調至尺字\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"710\",\"lineNum\":331,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"調而止。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014436393","endPageId":"7519875596014469161","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":3083,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":39,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817611302","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"711\",\"lineNum\":332,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"昔人以笛定律，每兩律同孔，所以有同字之律，皆不\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"712\",\"lineNum\":333,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"得正聲。然亦有可假用者。宋政和間作徵招，皆假之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"713\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014485545\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"714\",\"lineNum\":335,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"以見徵音是也。黄鍾下徵，假用黄鍾為變徵；黄鍾清\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"715\",\"lineNum\":336,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"角，假用林鍾為角，南吕為變徵；黄鍾為羽，太簇為變\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"716\",\"lineNum\":337,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"宫。大抵兩笛之調，唯黄、大二調七聲皆正，其餘皆有\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"717\",\"lineNum\":338,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"所假用。假用者皆濁一律，然吹之而其音適調者，蓋\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"718\",\"lineNum\":339,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"以所假之律與當用之律，兩音相去，原秪在毫髪之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"719\",\"lineNum\":340,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"間。且律管以數相生，參差不同，笛孔以音相次，均齊\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"720\",\"lineNum\":341,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"如一，自下至髙，七音自相和叶。故雖黄鍾均無大吕\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"721\",\"lineNum\":342,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"之律，大吕均無黄鍾之律，而其音可以互假。如琴以\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"722\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014501929\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"723\",\"lineNum\":344,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"中吕為黄鍾之角，髙一律而適調，此則濁一律而適\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"724\",\"lineNum\":345,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"調，皆聲律自然之變，而匏竹利制，尤不以數之不合\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"725\",\"lineNum\":346,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"而有所差池也。兩笛備十二調，與十二笛各成一調\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"726\",\"lineNum\":347,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"同，而器簡用周，易于度調，特為字譜，知音者或有取\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"727\",\"lineNum\":348,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"焉爾。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014469161","endPageId":"7519875596014501929","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":2324,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":40,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817627686","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"728\",\"lineNum\":349,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"右論兩笛十二調\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014501929","endPageId":"7519875596014501929","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":125,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":41,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817644070","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"729\",\"lineNum\":350,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"周禮大司樂：“圜鍾為宫，黄鍾為角，太蔟為徵，姑洗為羽。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"730\",\"lineNum\":351,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"函鍾為宫，太蔟為角，姑洗為徵，南吕為羽。黄鍾為宫，大\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"731\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014518313\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"732\",\"lineNum\":353,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"吕為角，太蔟為徴，應鍾為羽。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"733\",\"lineNum\":353,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"圜鍾，夾鍾也。函鍾，林鍾也。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014501929","endPageId":"7519875596014518313","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":680,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":42,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817660454","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"734\",\"lineNum\":354,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"此三大祀樂，皆四聲各為一調。范氏\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"735\",\"lineNum\":354,\"lineType\":2,\"content\":\"鎮\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"736\",\"lineNum\":354,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"云：“黄鍾為角\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"737\",\"lineNum\":355,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"者，夷則為宫。朱子語類以大吕為角，則南吕為宫；太\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"738\",\"lineNum\":356,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"蔟為徵，則林鍾為宫；應鍾為羽，則太蔟為宫。朱子所\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"739\",\"lineNum\":357,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"解與范氏同。注云有辟有不用者，謬也。隋志云：此四\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"740\",\"lineNum\":358,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"聲無商，又律吕乖次，以其為樂，無克諧之理。今古事\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"741\",\"lineNum\":359,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"異，不可得而行也。是不知四聲各為一調也。唐祀天\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"742\",\"lineNum\":360,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"神，圜鍾為宫，三奏，黄鍾為角，太蔟為徵，姑洗為羽，各\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"743\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014534697\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"744\",\"lineNum\":362,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"一奏。知其為四樂，而不言角、徵、羽屬何均，蓋即劉几\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"745\",\"lineNum\":363,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"所謂以聲為始終耳。宋用夷則之均一奏，謂之黄鍾\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"746\",\"lineNum\":364,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"為角，黄鍾為夷則之角也。林鍾之均二奏，謂之太蔟\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"747\",\"lineNum\":365,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"為徵，姑洗為羽，太蔟為林鍾之徵，姑洗又為林鍾之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"748\",\"lineNum\":366,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"羽也。最合經意，而劉几非之。四聲無商，先儒謂鬼神\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"749\",\"lineNum\":367,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"畏商之剛。朱子云：樂家言是有殺伐之意，故不用。然\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"750\",\"lineNum\":368,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"也。恐是無商調，不是無商音，奏起來五音依舊在。按\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"751\",\"lineNum\":369,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"朱子謂宫聲筵席不可用，用則賓主失歡，則先儒謂\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"752\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014551081\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"753\",\"lineNum\":371,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"鬼神畏商，容有是理。然古人佩玉，左宫羽，右徴角，亦\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"754\",\"lineNum\":372,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"不用商，豈人亦畏商乎？且以調法言之，黄鍾為宫，則\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"755\",\"lineNum\":373,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"太蔟為商，是有商音；應鍾為羽，則太蔟為宫，是兼有\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"756\",\"lineNum\":374,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"商調。大武之發揚蹈厲無所畏，而獨畏商，有殺伐之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"757\",\"lineNum\":375,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"意，夫豈然哉！\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014518313","endPageId":"7519875596014551081","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":3227,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":43,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817676838","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"758\",\"lineNum\":376,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"右論周禮三大祀樂\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014551081","endPageId":"7519875596014551081","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":128,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":44,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817693222","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"759\",\"lineNum\":377,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"宋史樂志徵、角二調，其均自隋唐間已亡。政和初，改用\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"760\",\"lineNum\":378,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"大晟律，至于徴招、角招，終不得其本均，大率皆假之以\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"761\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014567465\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"762\",\"lineNum\":380,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"見徵音。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014551081","endPageId":"7519875596014567465","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":527,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":45,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817709606","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"763\",\"lineNum\":381,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"鄭譯、祖孝孫為八十四調，有十二角調、十二徵調，而\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"764\",\"lineNum\":382,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"其均即失于隋、唐。宋景祐樂髓新經有徴、角二調，而\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"765\",\"lineNum\":383,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"彭几進樂書謂本朝以火徳王，而羽音不禁，徴調尚\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"766\",\"lineNum\":384,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"闕。大觀二年，劉詵上徴聲，詔令大晟府同教坊依譜\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"767\",\"lineNum\":385,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"按習，仍增徵、角二調，及為徵招、角招，終不得其本均。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"768\",\"lineNum\":386,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"蓋自為八十四調以來，原只有宫、商、羽而無徵、角，凡\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"769\",\"lineNum\":387,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"言徵調、角調，皆虗語耳。朱子語類問：温公言本朝無\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"770\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014583849\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"771\",\"lineNum\":389,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"徵音。曰：不特本朝，從來無那徵；不特徵無，角亦無之。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"772\",\"lineNum\":390,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"然只是太常樂無，宴樂依舊有也。只是無徴調、角調，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"773\",\"lineNum\":391,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"不是無徵音、角音。如説無徵，只是頭聲與尾聲不是\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"774\",\"lineNum\":392,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"徵，這却不知是如何，其中有箇甚麽欠缺處，所以做\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"775\",\"lineNum\":393,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"那徵不成。又云：徴調失其傳久矣，徽宗令人作之，作\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"776\",\"lineNum\":394,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"不成，只能以徵音起，而不能以徵音終。如今俗樂亦\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"777\",\"lineNum\":395,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"只有宫、商、羽三調而已。又云：俗樂無徵聲，蓋没安排\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"778\",\"lineNum\":396,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"處，及無黄鍾等四濁聲。以上三條雖小異，總言徵調\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"779\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014600233\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"780\",\"lineNum\":398,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"之失其傳，有音即有調，能起即能終，而無徵調幷無\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"781\",\"lineNum\":399,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"角調者，未易詰其所以然也。夫所謂徵調者，林鍾均，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"782\",\"lineNum\":400,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"林鍾為始終；所謂角調者，姑洗均，姑洗為始終，而當\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"783\",\"lineNum\":401,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"時俱謂之宫調。十二均各以其徵聲為始終，謂之十\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"784\",\"lineNum\":402,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"二徵調；十二均各以其角聲為始終，謂之十二角調。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"785\",\"lineNum\":403,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"然皆有其名，無其譜。細思其故，蓋以角、徴二音雜于\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"786\",\"lineNum\":404,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"一、上、勾、尺四字之間，音是則調非，律存則音失，不得\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"787\",\"lineNum\":405,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"其正聲，則不得其均，而其調亦遂不傳耳。黄鍾笛本\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"788\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014616617\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"789\",\"lineNum\":407,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"有蕤賓，無中吕。今觀文獻通考言太常笛從下而上\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"790\",\"lineNum\":408,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"第三穴為中吕，而蕤賓特為林鍾半竅之聲。其所以\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"791\",\"lineNum\":409,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"增中吕之位者，將欲用之也。吹笛之法，合、四之次，用\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"792\",\"lineNum\":410,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"上字則合本均，用一字則成别調。故俗樂以閏為角，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"793\",\"lineNum\":411,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"朱子琴律亦以中吕之徽為角，乃知雅樂名為姑洗，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"794\",\"lineNum\":412,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"其實不得不用中吕也。其所以存蕤賓之名者，亦有\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"795\",\"lineNum\":413,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"以用之也。吹笛之法，上、尺之間本無勾字之聲，而角、\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"796\",\"lineNum\":414,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"徵之間不得無變徵之律。中吕居蕤賓之位，則蕤賓\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"797\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014633001\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"798\",\"lineNum\":416,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"不得不居林鍾之位。故祖孝孫旋宫法因變徴為正\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"799\",\"lineNum\":417,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"徴，以不得正徵而假用變徴也。姑洗置而不用，清角\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"800\",\"lineNum\":418,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"進為正角，而角無正聲矣。林鍾失其所居，正徴轉為\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"801\",\"lineNum\":419,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"變徵，而徵無正聲矣。故在本均則無以為均，在各均\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"802\",\"lineNum\":420,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"亦無以為調，其𡚁皆由于以合字為黄鍾，而増中吕\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"803\",\"lineNum\":421,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"之位，一、上、勾、尺之間鶻突不分明，遂令角、徵二音進\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"804\",\"lineNum\":422,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"退皆無所據也。若以上字為宫，則五聲旋轉，自有一\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"805\",\"lineNum\":423,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"定之位次，彼雅樂俗樂，何嘗無徵、角哉？又按後周裴\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"806\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014649385\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"807\",\"lineNum\":425,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"正論七音，持林鍾作黄鍾，以為正調之首。故蘇祗婆\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"808\",\"lineNum\":426,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"琵琶七聲，商聲南吕，明其為林鍾均之七聲也。鄭譯\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"809\",\"lineNum\":427,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"始以太樂所奏七聲之内，三聲乖應，及彈蘇祗婆琵\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"810\",\"lineNum\":428,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"琶，自以為得七聲之正，而不知林鍾均之七聲，非正\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"811\",\"lineNum\":429,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"聲也。則其所以為調首者，先誤矣。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014567465","endPageId":"7519875596014649385","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":6855,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":46,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817725990","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"812\",\"lineNum\":430,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"右論徵、角二調\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014649385","endPageId":"7519875596014649385","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":125,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":47,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817742374","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"813\",\"lineNum\":431,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"魏書樂志：“瑟調以宫為主，清調以商為主，平調以角為\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"814\",\"lineNum\":432,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"主。五調各以一聲為主。\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null}],\"indent\":0,\"textIndent\":false}","startPageId":"7519875596014649385","endPageId":"7519875596014649385","contentEncryptType":0,"translateContent":"","chapterId":"1l9w1sn66801f","dataSize":284,"chapterOrder":13,"inChapterOrder":48,"volumeId":"7519875712287768611","volumeVersion":4},{"paragraphId":"7538597523817775142","paragraphType":1,"content":"{\"lines\":[{\"lineId\":\"815\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014665769\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"816\",\"lineNum\":435,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"五調者，第一平調，第二清調，第三瑟調，第四楚調，第\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"817\",\"lineNum\":436,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"五側調。陳仲孺謂依琴五調調聲之法，以均樂器。是\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"818\",\"lineNum\":437,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"五調本彈琴取聲合曲之名，各以一聲為均主，即黄\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"819\",\"lineNum\":438,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"鍾均五聲之旋宫也。楚、側二調，仲孺不言所主為徵\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"820\",\"lineNum\":439,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"為羽，未之詳也。清樂三調，即此五調之三。迎氣五引，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"821\",\"lineNum\":440,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"亦即此五調爾。唐志云：平調、清調，周房中樂遺聲。蓋\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"822\",\"lineNum\":441,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"此二調之曲，得其遺聲，非周時有此調名也。五調之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"823\",\"lineNum\":442,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"名，起于漢魏樂府，其平清瑟三調，總謂之清商。荀朂\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"824\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014682153\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"825\",\"lineNum\":444,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"取魏三祖舊詞為平清瑟三調歌曲，楚調則唯東阿\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"826\",\"lineNum\":445,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"王明月照髙樓一詩而已。自此以後，世特重平清瑟\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"827\",\"lineNum\":446,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"三調。謝靈運詩云：六引緩清唱，三調佇繁音。王僧䖍\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"828\",\"lineNum\":447,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"表論三調云：今之清商，實猶銅雀。魏氏三祖，風流可\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"829\",\"lineNum\":448,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"懐，京洛相髙，江左彌重。何妥非鄭譯毎宫立七調，議\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"830\",\"lineNum\":449,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"云：近代書記所載，縵樂鼓琴吹笛之人，多云三調。三\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"831\",\"lineNum\":450,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"調之聲，其來久矣，請存三調而已。唐時尚有平清二\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"832\",\"lineNum\":451,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"調之曲。五調雖係琴操曲弄，非雅樂之名，然各以一\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"833\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014698537\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"834\",\"lineNum\":453,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"聲為主，各成一調，非若黄鍾商、黄鍾角之類，同此一\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"835\",\"lineNum\":454,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"均，而别以一聲為始終也。凡樂毎奏一均，必先發其\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"836\",\"lineNum\":455,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"均主之聲，然後文之以五聲。至于曲終一聲，仍歸本\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"837\",\"lineNum\":456,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"均。古人立均，不過如此。故州鳩論武王七律，有上宫、\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"838\",\"lineNum\":457,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"下宫之名。姜䕫謂太樂外有所謂上宫調、下宫調。蓋\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"839\",\"lineNum\":458,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"其始也，發清黄之少宫，謂之上宫，則正聲為下宫；其\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"840\",\"lineNum\":459,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"始也，用短律之倍聲，謂之下宫，則正聲為上宫也。然\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"841\",\"lineNum\":460,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"總不出十二宫之外。其以商、角、徵、羽名調者，如徵招、\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"842\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014714921\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"843\",\"lineNum\":462,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"角招、清商、清角、清徴，皆琴操也。又有變商，亦謂之反\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"844\",\"lineNum\":463,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"商；有下徵，亦謂之流徵；又有變徵聲及羽聲，皆琴筑\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"845\",\"lineNum\":464,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"筝笛所用之調，謡俗之音，然總不出五調之外。故以\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"846\",\"lineNum\":465,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"律名調，則有十二宫，其名見于禮經而可施于今者\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"847\",\"lineNum\":466,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"也。以音名調，則有五調，其名起于後世而不戾于古\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"848\",\"lineNum\":467,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"者也。若八十四調，唯西凉、龜兹雜伎等曲數既多，故\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"849\",\"lineNum\":468,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"得𨽾于衆調，調各異曲，仍其舊可也，施于雅樂則悖\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"850\",\"lineNum\":469,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"矣。何妥非鄭譯之七調，而止請存三調，固為局而不\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"851\",\"lineNum\":0,\"lineType\":3,\"content\":\"\",\"pagePass\":{\"PageId\":\"7519875596014731305\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"852\",\"lineNum\":471,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"弘。牛弘議雅樂唯用宫聲，無用商、角、徵、羽為别調之\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"853\",\"lineNum\":472,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"法，其論甚正。而史譏何妥耻已不逮譯等，欲沮壞其\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"854\",\"lineNum\":473,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"事，并譏牛弘總知樂事，不能精知音律，蓋亦惑于七\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"855\",\"lineNum\":474,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"音十二律旋轉相交之，\",\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin\":null},{\"lineId\":\"856\",\"lineNum\":474,\"lineType\":1,\"content\":\"\",\"charPic\":{\"unicode\":\"\",\"url\":\"https:\u002F\u002Fp9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com\u002Ftos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2\u002Fread\u002FSK0610\u002F2\u002Fref\u002F1l9w3o2llzrqq\u002F1-SK0610_char_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1798848000&x-signature=8L8tJOdsVsM5LQ3ScotXkdG%2FRnc%3D\",\"uri\":\"read\u002FSK0610\u002F2\u002Fref\u002F1l9w3o2llzrqq\u002F1-SK0610_char_figure_00023.webp\",\"fontType\":0,\"components\":\"\",\"variants\":\"\",\"charPicId\":\"\"},\"logicSentenceId\":\"0\",\"marginNoteIdList\":null,\"pinYin
